capabilities: Receive AudioPen and VoiceNotes notes via a webhook into the vault
Render incoming notes from a custom Markdown template
Update or append to existing notes using the AudioPen note ID
Format AudioPen tags as Obsidian links or tags in properties
Link notes to daily notes using periodic notes settings
disambiguation: Not a device-to-vault sync like Obsidian Sync; it only receives notes pushed from AudioPen or VoiceNotes via a webhook.
extras: The README includes affiliate links to AudioPen and VoiceNotes and mentions GitHub Sponsorship; template tag variables do not handle empty states, so the author warns to include a fallback tag or link.
intentEvidence: based on the amazing work trashhalo did with obsidian-webhooks, but updated and extended
motivation: The author extended trashhalo's obsidian-webhooks work to support AudioPen and VoiceNotes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull transcribed voice notes from AudioPen or VoiceNotes into a vault.

relations.evidence: This is based on the amazing work trashhalo did with obsidian-webhooks
connects your editor to AudioPen or VoiceNotes to transcribe audio files
You can follow the same instuctions to add the webhook to VoiceNotes
uses settings in periodic notes plugin, or daily notes plugin if periodic notes isn't installed

summary: Webhook-based sync that receives AudioPen and VoiceNotes transcriptions into the vault as templated notes.
